# Independent PSD fixtures

Generated with psd-tools 1.25.0/Pillow by `scripts/validate_psd.py --fixtures
image-editor/tests/fixtures/psd`. No model weights or third-party artwork.

- external-rgb8.psd: opaque 4x3 background, 2x1 RGBA offset at (1,1), opacity 173;
  RLE background / ZIP foreground, neutral Blend If ranges.
- external-multiply.psd: same content with a Multiply foreground (supported since E03.2).
- external-mask.psd: standard Photoshop pixel mask (supported since E03.2).
- external-rgb16.psd: unsupported RGB16 document.

Rust tests read the checked-in binaries without Python installed.

E03.2 fixtures are generated by `scripts/validate_layer_psd.py --fixtures
image-editor/tests/fixtures/psd` with psd-tools 1.25.0/Pillow:
`layer-{normal,multiply,screen,overlay,disabled,offset}.psd` and reference PNGs.
Each has a 4x3 opaque RGB backdrop, RGBA source alpha128 / opacity173,
standard grayscale mask with 0/64/128/255, or a disabled mask, or a 2x1
mask at (1,1) with white outside coverage. Reference PNGs are independently
recomposited with `force=True, ignore_preview=True, apply_icc=False`.
The Rust suite needs no Python or model weights. See E03-LAYERS-VALIDATION.md
for re-export decoding and independent composite acceptance.
